cases.title: Record Visited Links to Global History
cases.description: Verify that standard visited links are successfully recorded to the Global History and check boundary conditions like private browsing and invalid URLs.

cases.title: Record Final Redirected URL to Global History
cases.description: Verify that the correct final link is recorded in the Global History after a server redirect, testing abnormal scenarios such as redirect loops.

cases.title: Launch History Link in Browser Window
cases.description: Verify that clicking on a history link causes it to be launched in a browser window correctly, and test boundary cases like invalid protocol handlers.

cases.title: Delete a Single History Entry
cases.description: Verify that a specific History entry can be deleted, and test edge cases such as attempting to delete non-existent entries.

cases.title: Delete Multiple History Entries
cases.description: Verify that multiple selected History entries are deleted and no longer displayed in the UI.

cases.title: Clear Global History
cases.description: Verify that the entire Global History can be cleared completely, including active session persistence checks.

cases.title: Group History Items
cases.description: Verify that history items can be properly grouped by Day, Site, or None views.

cases.title: Sort and Reverse-Sort History Columns
cases.description: Verify that history columns can be sorted and reverse-sorted correctly across text, numeric, and date data types.

cases.title: Resize History Columns
cases.description: Verify that history columns are resizable to show or hide more entry text, adhering to minimum and maximum width limits.

cases.title: Show and Hide History Columns
cases.description: Verify that history columns can be explicitly shown and hidden via interface options.

cases.title: Re-visit Sites via Back and Forward Dropdown
cases.description: Verify that recently visited sites can be re-visited by using the Back and Forward button dropdown menus.

cases.title: Create New Session History File
cases.description: Verify that a new, empty session history file is created for a brand new browser window or upon browser restart.

opinions.feedback: The proposed high-level test cases are well-structured and cover the requirements comprehensively with clear distinct scenarios.
All cases accurately test the corresponding requirements without any blockers or untestable boundary conditions.

analysis.analysis: R-073: Normal path records standard visited links; boundary tests include private browsing, invalid URLs, and local files. R-074: Normal path records the final redirected URL; abnormal paths involve redirect loops or aborted redirects. R-075: Normal path launches clicked link in browser window; boundary/abnormal cases include invalid protocol handlers or popup blockers. R-076: Single entry deletion; boundary includes deleting non-existent entries or locked DBs. R-077: Multiple entries deletion; boundary includes empty selections or massive batch deletes. R-078: Clears entire history; boundary includes active sessions and read-only storage. R-079: Groups by Day, Site, or None; boundary includes timezone shifts and malformed URLs. R-080: Sorts/reverse-sorts columns; boundary includes numeric, text, and date sorting. R-081: Resizable columns; boundary tests minimum and maximum width limits. R-082: Show/hide columns; boundary tests hiding all columns or resetting views. R-083: Back/Forward dropdown menu navigation; boundary tests empty history stacks. R-084: Creates new session history on window/restart; boundary tests crash recovery and corrupted profile directories.
